positions.name: BranchLibraryOperatingHoursAdjustment
positions.frame: how are branch library opening and closing hours adjusted to serve commuter book returns while maintaining flat staffing?
positions.why: Moira states the operational decision to open early at 8 a.m. on Tuesdays and Thursdays to accommodate commuter returns, while Teo notes the paired operational constraint of closing an hour earlier on those same days to keep total staffing hours flat.
